title: Reviewer failures get named categories, and a run that could not run never approves
summary: This change makes a reviewer's failure legible without ever echoing the reviewer's own text. A new `failure` module classifies a failed or timed-out reviewer's stdout/stderr into a fixed category (credential, quota, model unavailable, schema rejected, unreachable, command line, permission, unknown), and that category — plus exit code and elapsed seconds — becomes the reason recorded in the run. Timeouts are now carried as structured data (`Outcome::TimedOut`) so the binding limit, the kill result and the category are named from data rather than by re-reading wording. The reviewer home is always removed on drop (the `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME` escape hatch and its CI artifact uploads are gone), and `osf review run` now writes its `--out` file first, then exits 2 when a reviewer tried and nothing answered. Finally, the posted verdict follows the run's overall verdict: a run that could not run posts COMMENT, never APPROVE.

lanes.label: CI workflow
lanes.subtitle: GitHub Actions
lanes.summary: The three reviewer jobs no longer keep or upload a reviewer home; each still uploads its saved answers, and the final job decides by quorum.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The command that drives a review run: it writes the run file, decides the exit code, and posts the verdict.

lanes.label: Review engine
lanes.subtitle: review_run / reviewers / reducer

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: reviewer jobs + quorum job
nodes.summary: The workflow that runs each reviewer in its own job. This change removes the reviewer-home directory, the OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME and TMPDIR environment variables, and the diagnostic home artifact uploads from all three reviewer jobs.

nodes.label: reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: review-codex / -claude / -opencode
nodes.summary: One job per reviewer. It runs `osf review run`, then uploads the saved answers with `if: always()`, so a red job still leaves its artifact behind.

nodes.label: review job
nodes.subtitle: decides by quorum
nodes.summary: The final job runs even after a red reviewer job and decides by quorum rather than by any single reviewer job's result.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code
nodes.summary: Runs one reviewer, saves its run file first, then exits 2 when the reviewer made attempts and none answered. The saved file is what explains the red job.

nodes.label: post_run_outcome
nodes.subtitle: --post-to
nodes.summary: Posts the review. It now passes the run's overall verdict into the planner so the posted event follows the run, not just the findings.

nodes.label: plan_review_for
nodes.subtitle: findings + overall verdict -> Plan
nodes.summary: Chooses the posted event: a blocking finding or a failed run requests changes, a run that could not run comments, and a pass approves. `plan_review` delegates to it with no overall verdict.

nodes.label: review_run
nodes.subtitle: ReviewerRun / Attempts
nodes.summary: Drives a reviewer across lenses and attempts. It now scrubs every reason and context error, carries timeouts as data, and exposes `never_answered` so the CLI can decide the exit code.

nodes.label: never_answered
nodes.subtitle: tried && !answered
nodes.summary: True when a reviewer made at least one attempt or could not build a lens's context, and no attempt on any lens answered. An idle reviewer that tried nothing has not failed.

nodes.label: reviewers
nodes.subtitle: Outcome / Timeout / RunHome
nodes.summary: Spawns the reviewer's harness. `Outcome` gains a `TimedOut(Timeout)` variant carrying the waited time, kill result, category and whether the time ran out before start. `RunHome` is now always removed on drop.

nodes.label: failure::classify
nodes.subtitle: stdout + stderr -> Category
nodes.summary: Reads a failed reviewer's output and returns only a fixed category. JSON fields are read first, plain text patterns last; a status number counts only with HTTP context, and an explicit permission refusal outranks a quota or network word.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: private home, removed on drop
nodes.summary: A private, empty home for one reviewer run. It is now removed whole on every path out of a run — answer, failure, timeout or a command that never starts — and a home replaced by a link loses the link, not the folder it points to.

nodes.label: reducer::decide
nodes.subtitle: lens verdicts -> Verdict
nodes.summary: Reduces every lens's verdict into one. An empty lens set now counts as could-not-run at every threshold, so a review with no selected lens is never a pass.

nodes.label: answer::schema_for
nodes.subtitle: schema sent to a reviewer
nodes.summary: Builds the answer schema handed to a reviewer. It now strips `$schema` and `$id` before sending, because some harnesses refuse a schema naming a meta-schema they cannot resolve; the file keeps them for editors.

nodes.label: trusted_location
nodes.subtitle: masks reviewer-chosen keys
nodes.summary: Walks a validation error's instance path down the shipped schema and replaces every segment the schema does not name with `<field>`, so a reviewer-chosen key — even one made of digits — never appears in a reason.

nodes.label: reviewer harness
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
nodes.summary: The external agent process osf spawns. Its stdout and stderr are untrusted text that may hold a credential, so only a category derived from them ever reaches osf's output.

edges.label: runs each reviewer
edges.summary: The workflow defines one job per reviewer; this change removes the home-keeping environment and the home artifact upload from each.

edges.label: osf review run
edges.summary: Each reviewer job invokes the CLI, which now writes its run file before deciding the exit code.

edges.label: saved answers, if: always()
edges.summary: A red reviewer job still uploads its saved answers; the home artifact is gone.

edges.label: quorum, not job result
edges.summary: The final job runs after a red reviewer job and decides by quorum rather than by any reviewer job's result.

edges.label: run_reviewer + save
edges.summary: The CLI runs the reviewer, saves the run, then asks `never_answered` whether to exit 2.

edges.label: overall verdict
edges.summary: The posting path now hands the run's overall verdict to the planner, so a run that could not run posts COMMENT.

edges.label: run_reviewer
edges.summary: The run drives the reviewer module, which spawns the harness and returns an Outcome.

edges.label: never_answered()
edges.summary: The CLI asks the saved run whether the reviewer tried and nothing answered.

edges.label: classify(stdout, stderr)
edges.summary: On a non-zero exit or a timeout, the reviewer module classifies the partial output and keeps only the category.

edges.label: create / drop
edges.summary: Every run gets a private home, removed whole when the run ends, whatever ended it.

edges.label: spawn, drain pipes
edges.summary: The harness runs with only its own credential and a private home; its output is drained and classified, never printed.

edges.label: category in the reason
edges.summary: A timeout's reason appends the category as a hint, and every reason is scrubbed before it is saved.

edges.label: Verdict
edges.summary: The reducer's overall verdict is what the planner now follows when choosing the posted event.

edges.label: schema_error_reason
edges.summary: A schema validation error's instance path is masked against the shipped schema before it becomes a reason.

flows.title: A reviewer fails: output in, category out
flows.summary: What happens when a reviewer's harness exits non-zero or runs past its limit. The reviewer's own text is read once, classified, and never travels further; only a fixed category, the exit code and the elapsed time reach the run file, the journal and the posted review.

messages.label: stdout + stderr, untrusted
messages.note: The harness prints an error shape, possibly holding a credential.

messages.label: classify(stdout, stderr)
messages.note: JSON fields are read first, plain text patterns last; only a Category comes back.

messages.label: Category
messages.note: A fixed value whose wording osf owns, such as 'the provider rejected the credential'.

messages.label: Outcome::TimedOut / CouldNotRun
messages.note: A timeout carries the waited time, kill result, category and whether it ran out before start.

messages.label: scrub every reason
messages.note: Every reason and context error passes through the secret redaction before it is saved.

messages.label: ReviewerRun
messages.note: The run is saved first, so the artifact explains the red job.

messages.label: never_answered -> exit 2
messages.note: A reviewer that tried and nothing answered makes the job red, after the file is written.
